newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Cholera outbreak in Venezuela spreading, 11 dead.
newsitem.headline: Cholera outbreak in Venezuela spreading, 11 dead.

text.p: A cholera outbreak in Venezuela has killed 11 people among 289 cases reported and shows no sign of abating, health authorities said on Sunday.
All the deaths except one and 261 of the confirmed cases were in western Zulia state bordering Colombia, the Health Ministry's Epidemic Watch Unit said in a report.
So far 24 cases have been reported in Caracas. The capital city was declared in an epidemic emergency state on Dec. 17.
Cholera, primarily spread by poor hygiene or drinking water contaminated by sewage, causes severe diarrhoea, vomiting and dehydration.
